name: Gahz'ridian Detector
summary: The Gahz'ridian Detector is a device Marvon Rivetseeker devised to find the ornaments scattered across Tanaris. It helps him gather material for his studies of the troll-made carvings.

sections.title: A Desert Search
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker made the Gahz'ridian Detector to help locate ornaments carved from Gahz'ridian. Trolls fashioned the ornaments long ago in the image of Gahz'rilla, whom they worshipped as a deity. The carvings lie across Tanaris, with many found near Broken Pillar, Eastmoon Ruins and Southmoon Ruins.

faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker, a scientist and treasure hunter in Tanaris, invented the Gahz'ridian Detector.
The Gahz'ridian Detector helps locate ornaments carved from Gahz'ridian, a material named for Gahz'rilla.
Trolls who once occupied Tanaris carved the Gahz'ridian ornaments long ago.

faq.q: Why are the ornaments shaped like Gahz'rilla?
faq.answer: The ornaments were modeled after Gahz'rilla, a hydra the trolls worshipped as a deity.

faq.q: Where can I find Gahz'ridian ornaments?
faq.answer: Gahz'ridian ornaments lie throughout Tanaris, especially around Broken Pillar, Eastmoon Ruins and Southmoon Ruins.
